title: Decrement-control increment labels
statement: For a nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean tape alphabet, a decrement-control identifier $c$, a Boolean value $b$, and a natural number $i$ determine a label as follows: if $i<2$, the label is the increment label for $c$ and $b$ at index $i$; otherwise, it is the scale label for $c$ and $b$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet
